_readme: Copy to <meet>.json and fill in. Protocol: data/data_dictionary.md, 'Adding a meet'. The config is committed; the source file under data/private/ never is. Get source_sha256 from: python -m scripts.ingest_hytek --record <source_file>.
data_source: Official Hy-Tek results, <meet name> <dates>, Sanction #<n>, <event>, <exact URL> (retrieved YYYY-MM-DD, checksum-verified)
notes: anything a reader of the raw rows should know (event day ambiguity, field composition, etc.)
retrieval: how and when the source was saved and verified against the live page
